architecture.constructed_layout: Channels 0..9 retain inputs. Each consecutive triple after channel9 encodes one Boolean signal as h[j]+h[j+1]-h[j+2]. Unused channels are zero. This layout is intentionally available to algebraic comparators.
architecture.forward_definition: h=x; for i in range(4): h=relu(h@wi.T+bi); logits=h@out.T+bias; output=argmax(logits)

instruction: Construct this complete public Boolean truth table in the fixed four-stage ReLU network, starting from zero. Submit only {patch:[numeric operations]}.
